NEWSSUB: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd - 543965 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
HEADLINE: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Stock Exchanges that the Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru Bench has Sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation.
summary:
- On **30 September 2026** the Bengaluru bench of the National Company Law Tribunal (order C.A(CAA) No. 56/BB/2025) approved the scheme of amalgamation for **SPC International (India) Pvt Ltd** (the fourth transferor), following the earlier July 7, 2026 approval by the Chennai bench – thereby uniting five transferor companies into **TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd** (scrip code 543965).

- The amalgamation will become effective **upon filing the certified copies of these two NCLT orders with the Registrar of Companies** (the “Appointed Date” set in the scheme).
